reason: I'd take the free listing, sure, but my regulars already follow us on Instagram and book on WhatsApp, and that costs me nothing. I don't see why I'd pay 59 lari a month plus another payment fee to talk to guests I already reach.
objection: Another fee on every bill on top of my card terminal, and my waiters having to explain QR payments to guests who just want to hand over a card. A new platform in Tbilisi could be gone in a year too.
would_change_my_mind: If another restaurant owner I know showed me it brought them real repeat guests and the per-transaction fee was no higher than what my bank already takes.
